body: End-cap check, all 8 ops regenerated by name (camcraft-cli script, on a copy): posts clean, gate ok, no break-through applies (its holes are through: false with a typed floor). The cached-path post (camcraft-cli process) is byte-identical to the v0.21.0 program.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 2ab7ae424a12ce4c6b61b800f1cea089cfaa783a -->
Needs changes before merge.

The stated allowance reaches the drilling, boring, and thread kernels. The new fixture test confirms that a flute hit blocks posting. The default values preserve the existing golden results.

I reviewed the safety changes against current upstream `AGENTS.md` at `98f093fba91aea1b63cdd1498722ca9f7d73f428`. The trial merge was clean. All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Motion quick selection, 54 targets | 821 passed; 47 ignored |
| App quick selection, 467 targets | 3,394 passed; 34 ignored |
| UI quick selection, 11 targets, from `crates/ui` | 981 passed; 1 failed; 6 ignored |
| Clippy, motion/app/ui, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |

The quick gate returned failure because this UI test failed:
`egui_app::tests::ai_chat::safety::post_confirmation_allow_and_deny_gate_mcp_dispatch`.
The isolated rerun failed at the same point:

```text
crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/ai_chat/mod.rs:84:11
Harness::run exceeded max_steps (4).
```

I rebuilt the baseline crates and ran this test on upstream `98f093f`. It failed with the same message. This baseline failure is not an additional requested change for this PR.

Safety mutations ran in temporary source copies outside the PR checkout:

- Ignore the stated drilling clearance and use `THROUGH_CLEAR`: `a_stated_break_through_moves_the_deepest_feed` failed. It read `D: deepest -1 want -0.3`.
- Ignore the stated thread run and use one pitch: `a_through_hole_runs_one_pitch_unless_the_break_through_is_stated` failed. It read `the stated run bounds the tip: -7.5`.

Both targeted tests passed after I restored the temporary sources. No golden files changed. I checked the changes to the golden test inputs line by line. They retain the previous defaults.

Requested before merge:

1. **Correct the Spot depth note.** `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:2120` calculates a through-hole tip before the cycle kernel runs. A Spot cycle uses the entry dimple instead. A separate probe used entry Z10, floor Z0, and `break_through: Some(0.3)`. The actual tip stopped at Z8.000. The notes reported Z-0.300 and warned that the tool cut below stock. Derive the note from the actual cycle depth, or omit these break-through notes for Spot. Add a test for this case.

2. **Supply the UI evidence and assertions.** `crates/ui/src/egui_app/holes_page.rs:79` adds a visible Break-through row. The PR body has no before/after screenshots. It also states that structural tests are unchanged. Link the screenshots from the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch. Add structural assertions for the new controls and their units on Drill, Bore, and Thread. Do not add snapshot PNGs to this PR.

3. **Mark the project format change as breaking.** `crates/app/src/project/file.rs:104` raises the format from v62 to v63. Older readers refuse the new files. The commit has neither `!` nor a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. Add the breaking-change marker required by the current upstream Commits and Releases law.

4. **Place the pure helpers in the domain crate.** `crates/app/src/operation/break_through.rs:7` imports only domain values. The new module reads no ECS world, project file, command, MCP, or CLI. The current upstream Code shape law requires these pure helpers to live in the owning domain crate. Move the path and depth helpers there. Keep document reads in app.

The temporary probes and mutations changed no PR source. No screenshot, log, or review evidence was committed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

- Spot notes: omit through-exit and below-stock notes for Spot's entry dimple. `a_spot_dimple_does_not_claim_to_break_through_the_stock` pins entry Z10, floor Z0, allowance 0.3, actual tip Z8, and no false notes. Reverting the exclusion failed; restoring it passed. All six app break-through tests passed.
- UI evidence and assertions: `hole_break_through_default_controls_and_document_units` pins Drill, Bore and Thread controls, Default toggling, mm/in values, and Heights placement. `external_thread_has_no_hole_break_through_control` also passed. Removing the row calls failed the pin; restoring them passed. Before/after screenshots are linked in the PR body from the fork's images-only [pr-screenshots commit](https://github.com/mkinney/Camcraft/tree/ae6183eb/2126). No PNGs or review evidence are in this PR branch.
- Breaking format marker: the new commit has `!` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer for project format v63 and older-reader refusal. The commit-message assertion failed on the old message and passed on the new message.
- Domain helpers: moved the pure depth and path-note helpers into `camcraft-motion::break_through`. Document reads remain in app. `the_domain_helpers_pick_and_report_the_deepest_through_tip` passed; removing the domain export failed to compile; restoring it passed. Existing helper unit tests moved with the module.

New head: `2ba55d3748db1674a76de15581f6a376678298b5`.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is RED only on the baseline failure already identified in the latest review: `egui_app::tests::ai_chat::safety::post_confirmation_allow_and_deny_gate_mcp_dispatch`, `ai_chat/mod.rs:84`, `Harness::run exceeded max_steps (4)`. Motion: 825 passed, 47 ignored. App: 3,392 passed, 34 ignored. UI: 983 passed, 1 failed, 6 ignored. This excluded baseline issue was left unchanged.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` is GREEN.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking finding remains in this PR.

This was a safety review. I used the current upstream AGENTS.md at `57f2ffbbf51a32e9f71be6d4d0014184b1713f41`. The trial merge with that main was clean. All builds and tests ran locally. No GitHub runner was used.

The four earlier requests are met:

- Spot no longer gets a false through-exit note. Its regression test passed with entry Z10, floor Z0, allowance 0.3, and actual tip Z8.
- The PR body links before and after images for Drill, Bore, and Thread. I opened all nine images. They show the absent row, the default, and the stated value. The structural tests cover the controls, mm/in units, and Heights placement. The PNG files are on the fork's images-only branch. This PR changes no snapshot PNG.
- The new commit has `!` and a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer for project format v63.
- The pure depth and note helpers now live in `camcraft-motion`. The domain API test passed. App supplies the document values.

Local results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Trial merge: motion library and selected integration suites | 475 passed; 6 ignored |
| Trial merge: 10 app integration suites | 151 passed |
| Trial merge: motion and app clippy, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |
| Trial merge: UI library build | Failed on the upstream error below |
| Unmodified upstream main: UI library build | Failed with the same error |
| PR head alone: full UI library suite, from `crates/ui` | 908 passed; 6 ignored |
| PR head alone: UI clippy, all targets, `-D warnings` | Passed |

The app suites were `blind_floor`, `bore_entry`, `break_through`, `golden_cl`, `project_roundtrip`, `ream_cycle`, `rigid_tapping`, `solid_law_goldens`, `thread_mill`, and `thread_passes`. The motion integration suites were `blind_floor`, `break_through`, `center_cut_owed`, and `machining2d`.

The trial merge cannot build the UI because main has this error:

```text
error[E0004]: non-exhaustive patterns: `camcraft_app::machine::Kind::Waterjet` not covered
  --> crates/ui/src/machine_modes.rs:43:11
```

I reproduced it on unmodified upstream `57f2ffb`. Both affected source files are unchanged from main in the trial merge. This is not a requested change for PR #2126. The UI results above are from the PR head alone. They do not establish that the merged UI builds.

I ran two safety mutations in a temporary source copy:

1. Use the old `THROUGH_CLEAR` instead of the stated drill allowance. `a_stated_break_through_moves_the_deepest_feed` failed: `D: deepest -1 want -0.3`.
2. Use one pitch instead of the stated thread run. `a_through_hole_runs_one_pitch_unless_the_break_through_is_stated` failed: `the stated run bounds the tip: -7.5`.

Both tests passed after restoration. The fixture test also passed: a flute hit under the stock blocks posting. No golden output file changed. I checked the golden test input changes line by line. They retain the old defaults, and both golden suites passed.

Requested before merge: none.

The review changed no PR source. No screenshot, log, or review evidence was committed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Release-notes note: this PR raised the project file version to v63 (`PROJECT_VERSION` 62 -> 63), and its merge commit has no `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. Older CamCraft builds refuse a project saved by a build that has this change. The next release notes (v0.23.0) should list it under "breaking" for project files. Existing programs post the same output; only the file version changes.
